summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of TrainConnect Europe PWA. All 19 backend pytest cases passed (100%). All critical frontend flows working: home hero, popular routes, register/login, Stavanger->Athina multi-leg search (8 legs across NO/SE/DK/DE/AT/IT/GR), journey detail with live route map, add-to-cart, real Stripe test checkout session creation (redirects to checkout.stripe.com), stations list+map+departures panel, PWA manifest + sw.js reachable.

ui_bugs.issue: From/To station names not rendered in the heading - shows only two arrow glyphs and a fallback date 'DO., 01. JAN.'. URL only has from_id/to_id so page header has no station labels to display. Journey cards themselves render correctly.

issues: index.html has <link rel=preload> with unsupported 'as' value - emits 2 console warnings (non-blocking)

action_items: (Optional/low priority) On /search page, fetch station names from /api/stations/{id} or include from_name/to_name in URL so the page heading shows 'Stavanger -> Athina' instead of blank arrows + wrong date label
(Optional) Fix index.html <link rel=preload> 'as' attribute to remove console warnings
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~870 lines and contains models + routes + auth + payments + PDF gen + seed data in a single file. Consider splitting into modules (routers/auth.py, routers/journeys.py, services/stripe.py, data/seed.py) for maintainability if the codebase grows.
MongoDB _id is correctly excluded in all responses (uses pop('_id') / replaced with 'id') - good.
Stripe API key is read from env, JWT secret from env - good.
transport.rest fallback to curated synthetic data is well-implemented with try/except wrappers.
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes (excellent for testability).
auth/me endpoint correctly strips password from response.
popular-routes endpoint enriches from_id/to_id with full station objects (good DX).
journey_live computes status (scheduled/in_transit/arrived) + progress correctly via timestamps.
Login flow uses Bearer token via Authorization header - standard.
Note: /api/checkout/session and /api/cart accept optional_user - guest checkout supported.
Backend uses async motor + httpx properly - no blocking IO detected.
test_credentials: demo@trainconnect.eu / demo123 (created via /api/auth/register during test run)
seed_data_creation: Auto-seeded on backend startup: 54 stations + 8 popular routes. No manual seeding needed. Test also creates ad-hoc users with email pattern test_<uuid>@trainconnect.eu and qa_<timestamp>@trainconnect.eu.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are in /app/backend/tests/test_trainconnect.py - run with `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_trainconnect.py -v`. All 19 tests pass against the live preview URL. The Stavanger->Athina trunk route generates exactly 8 legs per spec. Stripe checkout creates real test sessions (verified URL contains checkout.stripe.com). The only minor visual issue is the /search page heading missing station labels (cosmetic only, journey cards work perfectly).
rca of the issue: N/A - no functional issues found. The /search page header missing station names is purely because the route component does not resolve station IDs from URL params to display names. To fix: in pages.jsx Search component, fetch stations on mount and look up by from_id/to_id, OR have SearchWidget pass &from_name=&to_name= in the redirect URL.
